asks: Asks the commission to keep the Mill Woods community whole within its riding and to respect community nuances; no request on any coded element.

Asks that Mill Woods and like communities be kept whole, that municipalities stay whole and urban ridings not be expanded into rural areas, and that new seats go to growth areas; no request on any coded element.

Asks that the two new seats go to south Edmonton and north Calgary, that provincial boundaries follow municipal boundaries (no Edmonton hybrids), and that communities be kept together; no request on any coded element.

Asks that Edmonton-City Centre keep its current boundaries (shedding Westwood or Spruce Avenue if needed), that Edmonton not be joined to surrounding towns, and that one new seat go to Edmonton; no request on any coded element.
Asks that Edmonton-Highlands-Norwood keep its existing boundaries; no request on any coded element.
Asks the commission to respect city limits and keep her Edmonton-Decore constituency inside Edmonton, not joined to Morinville, St. Albert, Fort Saskatchewan or Sturgeon County.

quote: I don’t want to be pulled out into Morinville, St. Albert, Fort Saskatchewan, Sturgeon county.
note: St. Albert named only as a place an Edmonton riding should not be joined to; says nothing about how St. Albert and Sturgeon County are arranged. Said in answer to Mr. Clark; text falls after the EB-92 label (in the preceding record) and before EB-93.

quote: From Alberta Beach to Valleyview to Lethbridge
note: Lethbridge named only as a place she visited as a child.

asks: Asks that like communities be kept together and municipal boundaries respected, and that the two new seats go one to Edmonton and one to Calgary; no request on any coded element.

quote: growing up mostly in Kinuso in the middle of Lesser Slave Lake constituency
note: Lesser Slave Lake named only as where she grew up and as an example of a representative who knew her rural community; no request about the district.

asks: Asks that city boundaries and like communities be respected and that Edmonton-South West be made smaller to reflect its growth; no request on any coded element.
Asks that Edmonton-South West be split into two ridings kept inside Edmonton; no request on any coded element.
Asks that Sherwood Park be kept largely as drawn in 2017 and flags growth in Cambrian, Bremner and Ardrossan; no request on any coded element.
Asks for one compact urban Sherwood Park riding (boundary moved from Clover Bar Road to Highway 21, including Hillshire) and a squared-off Edmonton-Meadows; no request on any coded element.

Asks that municipal borders be respected (no Edmonton-Sherwood Park or rural-urban ridings), that new seats go to growth areas, and that central Edmonton ridings such as Riverview not change much; no request on any coded element.

quote: then the MP for Airdrie-Cochrane can focus on issues that smaller urban centres may be facing and rural areas as well
note: Praises the federal commission's Airdrie-Cochrane riding as an example of better representation; a federal example, not a request about provincial Airdrie districts. Text falls after the EB-102 label (end of the preceding record) and before EB-103.

quote: then the MP for Airdrie-Cochrane can focus on issues that smaller urban centres may be facing and rural areas as well
note: Federal Airdrie-Cochrane riding cited approvingly as an example; no request about the provincial Cochrane district. Text falls after the EB-102 label (end of the preceding record) and before EB-103.

asks: Asks that whole communities and neighbourhoods in far northeast Edmonton be kept together and divided along major roads; no request on any coded element.

Asks that west Edmonton growth areas stay in Edmonton-West Henday rather than join Drayton Valley-Devon (north of the Yellowhead could move to Glenora), and that one new seat go to Edmonton; no request on any coded element.
Asks for Indigenous names for districts, that districts not be drawn along racial lines, and that sites of spiritual and historical significance be researched; no request on any coded element.

Asks that seats follow municipal boundaries (Calgary, Edmonton, Lethbridge and Red Deer wholly inside city limits), two more seats for Calgary, one more for Edmonton, one more in the Airdrie metro area, one seat inside each mid-size city (St. Albert, Airdrie and others) with an adjoining hybrid, and two fewer rural seats.

quote: This would remain the same: two seats each, as is currently the case, for the cities of Lethbridge and Red Deer. Only minor adjustments to existing boundaries are needed to equalize population between electoral divisions in these cities.
note: Also opens by saying that for Calgary, Edmonton, Lethbridge and Red Deer all seats should be contained within city boundaries (before the EB-110 label, record pp. 153-156).

quote: This would remain the same: two seats each, as is currently the case, for the cities of Lethbridge and Red Deer. Only minor adjustments to existing boundaries are needed to equalize population between electoral divisions in these cities.
note: Also says all Red Deer seats should be contained within city boundaries.

quote: What I’m suggesting is that Airdrie could have a seat all by itself. With the current population of about 85,000, it’s still going to be about 30,000 above the threshold, so a chunk of Airdrie would then have to still be combined either on the east or west.
note: Wants one seat wholly inside Airdrie plus an adjoining seat taking the rest of the city with Rocky View County (east or west), and one added seat for the metro area north of Calgary. Neither A1 (both Airdrie districts take rural area) nor A3 (no rural area); no Calgary link. Said in answer to Mr. Evans.

quote: especially the cities of Airdrie and Chestermere, the town of Cochrane, and Rocky View county are also experiencing above-average population growth
note: Cochrane named as a growth area and as part of the current Airdrie-Cochrane arrangement; no request about who Cochrane should share a district with.

quote: especially the cities of Airdrie and Chestermere, the town of Cochrane, and Rocky View county are also experiencing above-average population growth
note: Chestermere named only as a growth area in the Calgary metro.

quote: One seat each within the boundaries of the cities of Grande Prairie, St. Albert, Airdrie, Medicine Hat, the regional municipality of Wood Buffalo, and the hamlet of Sherwood Park, with an adjoining seat in the immediate vicinity of these urban centres.
note: In answer to Mrs. Samson he adds that St. Albert has an urban seat and about a quarter or third of its population in with Sturgeon, 'where I think there is a community of interest' (also EB-110). No particulars beyond the long-standing pattern.

asks: Asks that Edmonton-West Henday stay largely the same and inside Edmonton, that a new seat go to south Edmonton, and that First Nations be grouped together: Piikani into Cardston-Siksika, Horse Lake into Central Peace-Notley, O'Chiese and Sunchild into Drayton Valley-Devon, and the Eden Valley and Big Horn Stoney reserves reunited with the Stoney Nakoda in Banff-Kananaskis.

quote: The Eden Valley reserve and the Big Horn reserve in Rimbey-Rocky Mountain House-Sundre, which are both part of the Stoney Nakoda Sioux Nation, and where they are presently divided up by electoral boundaries which disconnect them from their First Nations in Banff-Kananaskis: I would recommend reuniting those areas.
note: Wants the Big Horn reserve (now in Rimbey-Rocky Mountain House-Sundre) and Eden Valley (Livingstone-Macleod) put in one district with the Morley Stoney Nakoda reserves (Banff-Kananaskis). This speaks to Stoney lands and the Rocky riding but fits no listed option: the minority puts Big Horn and the Morley reserves together in the Rocky Mountain House riding, the majority puts the Morley reserves in Canmore-Banff and Big Horn presumably with Clearwater County. Needs a lookup of where Big Horn 144A and Eden Valley fall on each map. Repeated at the map: 'the inclusion of these two into Banff-Kananaskis would bring them back in line with their counterparts' (EB-114).

quote: where O’Chiese is one voice in Rimbey-Rocky Mountain House-Sundre
note: Names the riding as one where O'Chiese is a lone First Nation and asks that O'Chiese and Sunchild go to Drayton Valley-Devon. Says nothing about keeping or dividing Clearwater County or the riding itself; coded as a mention.

quote: The needs of those residents are different than even nearby St. Albert
note: St. Albert named only as a comparison (Morinville differs from St. Albert, St. Albert and Spruce Grove differ from Edmonton). Text falls after the EB-112 label at the end of the preceding record.

quote: Good examples of this are already happening, like I just mentioned, including Fort McMurray-Lac La Biche, Bonnyville-Cold Lake-St. Paul, Lesser Slave Lake
note: Lesser Slave Lake cited as a good current example of a district grouping several First Nations; no request about the district.

asks: Asks that municipal and community boundaries be respected, that Edmonton-Beverly-Clareview not be joined with Sherwood Park, that diversity be weighed, and that the riding keep its name; no request on any coded element.
Asks for representation by population: new seats in Calgary and Edmonton, a few rural ridings absorbed into neighbours, and no blending of rural and urban areas; no request on any coded element.

quote: For example, in 2024 Lesser Slave Lake had 15,704 listed voters; Edmonton-South West had 41,428.
note: Lesser Slave Lake used as an example of rural over-representation; she suggests 'a few rural ridings might need to be absorbed' but names none. Rule 6: example, not a stance. Text falls after the EB-118 label at the end of the preceding record.
